description: Declared inputs for the reduced card-work provisioning profile. tools/derive_card_profile.mjs turns this file, the recorded gate-read observations and a static reference scan into the committed sparse pattern list and closure manifest. Edit this file, never the generated outputs.

rollup.note: A directory is emitted as a single pattern only when every tracked file beneath it is in the profile set. Otherwise the directory's members are emitted individually, so a byte-heavy tree can never be pulled in by a directory pattern.

static_scan_hops_note: The scan starts at the seeds and follows references one further hop, which is what carries a Worker source across the boundary into a site/ module and then on to that module's data files. Deeper expansion pulls in the data references of browser modules that only full-checkout-only gates load; a source the profile materialises but does not scan still fails closed through tools/card_profile_sentinel.cjs if a supported gate ever reads a path it needs.
static_seed_note: The transitive static reference scan starts from the Worker package, because every Worker source is materialised and any of them can be loaded by the Worker unit family, and from every source a supported gate class was observed to load. It follows references across the worker/-to-site/ boundary and keeps following them.
defer_note: A statically-referenced path inside one of these byte-heavy trees is materialised only when a supported gate class was observed to read it, or when a seed-tree source references it directly. Everything else is deferred to explicit hydration.

exclude_tree_rationale.artifacts: Captured comparison images and projection payloads; 58.6 MiB, read only where a gate names a specific file.
exclude_tree_rationale.data: Tracked geography inputs consumed by builders that are full-checkout-only.
exclude_tree_rationale.docs/performance: Performance report payloads; no in-profile gate reads them wholesale.
exclude_tree_rationale.docs/screenshots: Documentation imagery; no in-profile gate reads it.
exclude_tree_rationale.entity_resolution: Review and evaluation payloads consumed by resolution builders, which are full-checkout-only.
exclude_tree_rationale.site/agencies: Tracked per-agency projections; the Worker family reads a bounded subset.
exclude_tree_rationale.site/data: The measured 445.5 MiB dominant. Only the observed and statically referenced closure is materialised.
exclude_tree_rationale.site/media: Tracked media payloads served by the site build, which is full-checkout-only.
exclude_tree_rationale.site/parcels: Tracked parcel projections read by full-checkout-only builders.
exclude_tree_rationale.warehouse: Materialised source observations consumed by the opt-in warehouse workflow.
exclude_tree_rationale.worker/src/data: 53.9 MiB of the Worker's 58.4 MiB. Only the lookups the Worker unit family actually opens are materialised.

full_checkout_only.title: Site standards, i18n and copy lint family
full_checkout_only.reason: The standards suite walks the whole tracked site tree, including the excluded site/data, site/agencies and site/media payloads.

full_checkout_only.title: Site and contract unit suites
full_checkout_only.reason: test/*.test.mjs and test/contract/*.test.mjs read tracked builder inputs across site/data, data/ and entity_resolution/.

full_checkout_only.title: Generated-document and source-contract checks
full_checkout_only.reason: The owning builders read and rewrite tracked projections across the excluded trees.

full_checkout_only.title: RCP-03 evidence placement receipt
full_checkout_only.reason: Measured to read 3,535 tracked paths totalling 615.4 MiB, which is close to the whole tracked tree.

full_checkout_only.title: Reading-level ratchet gate
full_checkout_only.reason: Walks the served site documents, which the profile does not materialise.

full_checkout_only.title: Accessibility, browser and performance families
full_checkout_only.reason: They serve the built site, which requires the generated Pages build over the full tracked payload.

full_checkout_only.title: Generated site build
full_checkout_only.reason: The Cloudflare Pages build reads the complete tracked site payload.

full_checkout_only.title: Release-surface and deployment checks
full_checkout_only.reason: Release evidence is derived from the full tracked tree and from generated build output.

full_checkout_only.title: Guards that resolve a merge base against main
full_checkout_only.reason: A depth-limited profile cannot supply a merge base. The default card profile keeps complete commit history for exactly this reason; the opt-in --depth variant must be unshallowed first.

full_checkout_only.title: Repository control-plane cutover receipt
full_checkout_only.reason: It asserts that every retained evidence projection resolves on disk, and it does so with an existence check rather than a content read. CI-09's recorder deliberately records only content reads, because recording metadata probes grew the closure to the whole tracked tree, so this gate's true closure was never observed. Its retained set reaches into site/data, warehouse/ and docs/screenshots, which the profile defers, and it was measured failing in a reduced checkout at this revision.
